Black ASA. 4 mm walls minimum, 3 perimeters, 15% infill. Halves fit any bed over 160 mm. The assembled case is 283.8 x 154.8 x 49 mm, 53 mm off the wall with feet.

Hardware

  • 20 × M2.5 × 12 black cap screws, faceplate
  • 4 × M2.5, 4 to 8 mm, screen to the corner tabs (length set at the dry fit)
  • 4 × M2.5 × 20, joins the two halves
  • 3 × M3 × 30, door hinge pins (yours)
  • 2 wall screws for the keyholes, 150 mm apart

HDMI adapter + straight plugtight

The adapter plus a straight full-size HDMI plug needs roughly 50 mm past the port. The case has 36 mm down the edge or 37 mm toward the wall. A short flexible right-angle HDMI extension solves it. Hole positions, plug lengths and the Pi case size are estimates until the Nov 10 dry fit.
